title: Footsteps
body:
Madad Ya Rijalullah, O Allah's beloved ones, His special servants, His Glorified Habib (sws)...
the ones who hold fast to his way Mashallah to you! A new day... We are entering it with new
power, Inshallah! Madad. For 3 days...we were given a pause. Today, the permission to speak
came. I am hoping that this... will help the world of Islam to conquer and the world of kufur to
be shaken. The world of kufur is already built on top of rubbish. It is a nonsense establishment.
The building of Islam... is a castle! A castle that cannot collapse belongs to Islam! If that is
so...let's listen. Don't look at the one who's speaking. Listen to the one who's making me speak.
Stand up! Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar! La ilaha illa Allah Huwa Allahu Akbar
Wa La Hawla Wa La Quwwat illa Billah al Aliyul Adheem . O Glorious Messenger (sws) we are
standing to glorify you, to glorify Allah (swt)...we... What we are capable of is very little. Today is
Thursday. It is a blessed day. We stood up for our Lord (swt)... His Great Name His Name, Jalal.
Allahu Allah Allahu Allah Allahu Allah Allahu Allah Allahu Allah Allahu Allah Allahu Allah
Rabbi Dhul Jalal Rabbi Dhul Jalal Rabbi Dhul Jalal Allahu Akbar Allahu Allah Allahu Allah
Allahu Dhul Jalal Allah Dhul Jalal Subhansin Ya Rabb 3 days... to get the attention of people.
We were given an order to speak after 3 days. It is for a reason, an occasion. Then let us say,
Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim. Recite Basmala...
Stand up stand up...stand up Allah's (swt) Great Name is being mentioned. Bismillahir Rahmanir
Rahim Hu...with its blessings for the sake of awliya (saints) and prophets we received permission
to speak a few words. Let's us see what there is. O those who are present! Marhaba Ay Yaran
Shah Mardan with his sword... If he strikes the world, it will divide into 2 like a watermelon,
don't have any doubts! There are no doubts in Islam. Anyone who has doubts, goes out of Islam.
Anyone who doesn't believe in the greatness of Islam, goes out of Islam. May Allah (swt) protect

us.
Did we say, Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim? Jalla Jalaluhu Jalla Jalaluhu Jallah Adhamatuhu Wa
La ilaha Ghayruhu Allahu Akbar wa Lillah al Hamd Shah Mardan... Those who carry love for
him, those who love and respect Shah Mardan, Ay Yaran Shah Mardan our assembly is the
assembly of Shah Mardan. Listen... Say...Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim. For what occasion were
these 3 days delayed. There is an occasion/reason Allah (swt)...now Shah Mardan... we will
speak from the addressing of Shah Mardan, pay attention! Be careful/ pay attention. The
addressing of Shah Mardan is the addressing of Haqq. Don't make fun or by next week...or
within 40 days, you will leave this world. Stand strong/ firm. Stand with Adab. Tawba Ya
Rabbi, Tawba Ya Rabbi Tawba Astaghfirullah. Let us repent. That is what Shah Mardan wants.
Ay Yaran Shah Mardan. O people who love Shah Mardan, those who love his way, those who
want to follow the footsteps and way of that Lion, Salam to you. Yaran Shah Mardan our
assembly... is the assembly of beloved ones. Who are the beloved ones? Beloved ones...are the
ones who love Shah Mardan... the ones who follow his way, Allah (swt) and His Prophet (sws)...
the ones who love them and sacrifice themselves for their way. They are the holy ones. Take...
Listen... What is the reason... why did they postpone this assembly? Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim
now... I have nothing to say from myself. Shah Mardan... like Dhul Fiqqar... his sword is in his
hand. Dhul Fiqqar it is calling. What did Allah (swt) say? O Muslims... What did he mention?
Listen, listen to Shah Mardan. "Wa antumul a'launa in kuntum mu'minin." (3:139) Understand?
Is it right? "Wa antumul a'launa in kuntum mu'minin." (3:139) Allah (swt) is saying: O people
who are claiming to be Muslims, O people who claim to be Mumin (believers), they should
know... Wa antumul a'launa in kuntum mu'minin. (3:139) Allah (swt) - Greatness, Magnificence;
the attribute of Magnificence... belongs to Allah (swt). Azamatu Kibriya is special only for Him.
Oh believers, "wa antumul a'launa... in kuntum mu'minin" - you are believers... you are superior.
Oh kings! Oh Princes! Oh people who put themselves in charge and claim to be leaders of the
nation, Listen. When do you receive greatness? "Wa antumul a'launa in kuntum mu'minin".
When is the crown of superiority dressed on your head? if you are believers, if you say, 'I am a
believer', then you will be great; you will be high. Allah (swt) has given you greatness. "Antumul
a'launa in kuntum mu'minin" if you are believers, you have been given greatness and honor and

Allah (swt)... let's come to a sensitive point because, Shah Mardan has now drawn his sword. He
is saying, Allah (swt) is saying: "Wa antumul a'launa in kuntum mu'minin"- if you are believers,
Allah (swt)... will give you greatness and honor above the greatness given by Allah (swt)... there is
no greatness, finished. "Wa antumul a'launa in kuntum mu'minin." I am Iranian, I am Turk, I
am Saudi Arabian, I am Egyptian, I am Sudani, I am Libyan, these aren't accepted. If you are
believers, you are given greatness and honor, you are great, you are great...okay
"Wa antumul a'launa in kuntum mu'minin". If you are not believers, those who are faithless have
no greatness; they are nothing, zero. Very well, the one who is running after people... and
especially running after the Islamic world... and the one using all the armies, is satan. It is satan.
Allah (swt) is saying: "Wa antumul a'launa in kuntum mu'minin". O believers, you will be given
greatness if you are believers. Don't you dare say, I am... the leader of this country, its king, its
prince. Where did you get your greatness from? Greatness is given... "Wa antumul a'launa in
kuntum mu'minin". Other than this, other than iman (faith)... you have no honor. A man without
faith is a man without honor. A man without faith is satan's servant, satan's donkey, an animal.
What is satan calling for? To make people his animal. All his desire and revenge... is to make
Islamic believers tied to him, to make them follow him. With the littlest thing, satan ties people
to himself - that is his job. What did Allah (swt) say? "Wa antumul a'launa in kuntum mu'minin."
You are believers and Allah (swt)... our Lord is saying... oh people of Islam, oh believers "Wa
antumul a'launa in kuntum mu'minin" (3:139). For you, believers, Allah (swt)... gave superiority,
greatness. There's no greatness for you from anything else O Shah Mardan, draw Dhul Fiqqar!
so you can strike those leaving this way.
What is Allah (swt) saying, O Princes, O Kings, O leaders of Islam, those in charge, those
wanting to be in charge? What is He saying? "Wa antumul a'launa in kuntum mu'minin". This
greatness is given to you because you are believers! Apart from that, Allah (swt) is saying: Ya
ayyuha llathina 'Amanu Latattabi'u Khutuwati-sh Shaytani (24:21). It is a holy verse? The
countries of the Islamic world... the head writer, Mr. Akmaluddin, I am asking him too... Is it
correct? "Wa antumul a'launa in kuntum mu'minin." Is that right? What is Allah (swt) saying? Ya
ayyuha Llathina 'Amanu Latattabi'u Khutuwati-sh Shaytani (24:21) Is it okay?
Oh kings, listen! If you don't, within 40 days, you won't make it to Ramadan. This is an

addressing from Shah Mardan, It's not a joke. To Iranians, to Turks, to people of Sham, to those
in Hijaz (arabian peninsula), India, China, this is for them too. Latattabi'u Khutuwati-sh
Shaytani (24:21) - don't follow the footsteps of satan! Is that right? Yes it is. "Latattabi'u
Khutuwati-sh Shaytani" (24:21) very well. For 3 days they delayed me, the Sultan Shah Mardan,
stop and tell them later was the order. He gave permission to speak today. Now we will ask, pay
attention! Latattabi'u Khutuwati-sh Shaytani (24:21) Hz. Rasul (sws)... said... What did he say?
Listen from Shah Mardan Listen oh kings! The 'heavy cannon' is now coming! Latattabi'u
Khutuwati-sh Shaytani (24:21) Despite this order... what I do and what comes to my heart...
there's permission to speak from the words of Shah Mardan - we will speak. Shah Mardan heard
from our Prophet (sws) SalawatuLlahi wa Salamu 'Alayh. Subhan Allah. Latattabi'u Khutuwatish
Shaytani (24:21).
Despite this (verse), what did our Prophet (sws) say? Listen, Akmaluddin and kings and princes Latattabi'unna Khutuwati-sh Shaytani. "you will follow step by step, the people/nations before
you" even... if one of them enters the hole of a lizard...for sure... you will say, 'there is some
wisdom' and you will enter also. (Hadeeth) oh scholars, of princes, oh kings, Listen! Allah's
beloved - creation was created for his honor - what is he saying? "Latattabi'u Khutuwati-sh
Shaytani". When it is in the Quran... What will you do, it is saying. What will they do?
Latattabi'unna,the "Lam" is to make certain (Arabic grammar) . "Nun"is too for certainty(A.
grammar) "Latattabi'unna Khutuwati-sh Shaytani" You will follow the steps of satan step by step.
You will follow exactly every step of satan. You are taking all their satanic ways as a direction
and path. To what extent? For everything, everything. There is even a small animal... it's home
is a narrow hole, it only fits him and no other animal. It hides there. What will you do, it is
asking? This is the saying of Prophet.
O kings,do not sleep!You won't make it to Ramadan. No king or prince (will make it). Prophet
(sws) did not say anything useless and Shah Mardan is saying - don't follow him. They ride in
cars. Don't ride in cars, ride on camels. Don't be like them. Shame on people!Now an important
issue is going to be told. You will follow step by step. "Latattabi'unna sunan alladhina qablakum."
You are following the steps of the old ignorant nations, following them carefully. Pay attention.
Like what? Our prophet (sas) is explaining. If you see a small animal entering its hole will you
follow it there? Shame on you, pity you. Shah Mardan the son of the uncle of the Holy

Prophet, What is the Pride of the universe, our Holy Prophet, saying? You think it is fashion to
follow them step by step? "Wa antumul a'launa" But You are supreme. Oh kings! Allah gave you
greatness. Oh! I have cars, I have airplanes, I have boats. Leave these things otherwise you
may not reach to Ramadan. The Owner of the heavens, Jabbar Allah Qahhar Allah will sweep
them all away. He won't do it Himself but one of His weak servants will deal them.
For what reason am I emphasizing this issue, Sadaqa RasuluLlah Sall'Allahu Alayhi wa Sallam?
For what? Three nights ago what did the enemies of Islam do? The hours were turned forward.
Ugh? Oh kings have you heard this? Of course you heard. Is it the command of Allah Almighty
or The Holy Prophet? What is this? You have no shame, you have no faith.Dont you have
religion? Where that small animal is, the leaders of my ummah will follow. The unbeliever
Europe has taken the hours forward. O Kings this addressing is to you. The leaders of Islamic
world are you leading or following? This is why I have paused for three days, because of this
burden. Does Islam not have honor ? Why are you making yourself tails of animals? You are
the head. Europe has taken the clock forward. Who gave you the authority to change the hours?
Say! Akmaluddin! If not you will not reach Ramadan. I am angry because of this. All
Awliyaullah are angry, why? These are the footsteps of shaytan.
Our time is different. Why do you change the time according to the footsteps of shaytan. Shame
on our kings. What a shame on our government and on the Islamic world. Our world is
different, their world is different. Shame on you! Be afraid of Allah. Be ashamed before the
Prophet or you will not reach Ramadan. This is what makes me angry. For three days, with
anger I am waiting permission to address the people. Our people immediately took the hours
forward. By whose command? Unbeliever Europe's? We follow them, we get on very well with
them. We get on well with Israel. What are you going to do? You are going astray. This is not
the path of Allah Almighty. Does Islam not have honor? Is it under the tail ? Islam is the head.
Do you have the right, Europe, to take the time forward? What's happening to our people? Are
we their servants? Are we under their command? Shame on our kings, our scholars, our prime
ministers. If they are not putting the hours back - till Ramadan - The angel of Death is
waiting. Three times in a day the Angel of death is looking for your name. Now seven times he
is looking, also for our kings. Rulers, princes, are responsible too.

What right does Europe have? Muslims invented the clock. Now they follow the footsteps of
shaytan (24:21). Why do you follow them? Ride on a camel, do not drive their cars. Drive your
car, don't get on their plane. Sail on your boat, don't get on their ships. We are Muslims! We
have honor. Those ones calling themselves leaders, Beware! Your punishment is ready. For
what reason are we changing our time? Are we the monkey of Europe? Are we the servant of
Europe? Don't we have honor? Muslims invented the clock. Europe is moving the hours. I dont
know whether the Jewish or Jesuits priests made this up. Lets unite the Islamic world. We will
lead them. They will be the tails. Shame on our kings, our scholars, presidents of republics and
leaders. If you don’t correct the hours, Ekmeleddin effendi, you will not reach Ramadan.
Correct the time. We are not Europe's servant or monkey.
We are full, let Shah Mardan speak. Ey Shahi Mardan! Those who don't believe, experience is
free. Their graves will be ready by Ramadan. Who is Ekmeluddin? Who is king? Who is sultan?
Who is prince? doesnt matter. There is a Command from heavens. Correct the time! Watch the
honor of Islam. Islam is not Europe's servant. Europe has taken the hours forward. What a job!!
We have our time, why follow theirs? Do you like it? If not your grave is being prepared. Finish.
This is the issue: moving the time. Whose command ? -Europe's. Are we donkeys of Europe?
Where is the honor of Islam ? They must follow us! Our people immediately take the hours
forward. Is the time under your command? Hours are as they come from heavens. Who is
ordering to change the hours? They are unbelievers who don't know religion or faith. Where is
your honor? The honor of Islam? Tell Ekmeluddin to answer this.
O Kings, the King of Hijaz, scholars, successors, all of you, instead of fighting each other
defend Islam otherwise your graves will be ready by Ramadan. This command is severe. Shahi
Merdan, Shahibul Maydan, those who are not afraid come to the arena(maydan), For three days
I have been burdened, now I have permission to speak about it. About what? This hours issue.
Our Holy Prophet (sas) didnt say for nothing:"Latattabi'unna Sunana Lladhina qablakum.(You
will tread the same path as was trodden by those before you, inch by inch, step by step. If they
entered the hole of lizard, you would follow also. Did he say this to praise? Scholars, answer this
for Allah's sake - The scholars of Egypt, the scholars of Hijaz and the scholars of Turkey.
"Fa Man Tashabaha Bi Qawmin Fahuwa Minhum" Who makes himself like a people, he is one

of them. We are not unbelievers, why follow them? This is our time. Don't use the European
style. Use Alaturka, Ottoman style watches, to be known. Don't put it on your wrist. Don't put it
on your arm like a bracelet. Women are to put on jewelry, not men! Ehh! He has a gold watch.
Bree! Gold is for women. Why does a man put it on their arm? He is saying it is a gold watch.
No use, no value. Use our old watches,hanging from the pocket. The writing on it is also Islamic.
Time - the day starts with sunset till the following day. Pay attention to this. Now,no one knows
any boundaries. Even Akmaladdin doesn't say anything about this. Why don't you say anything?
"Wa Antumu Al A`lawna In Kuntum Mu'uminina"(3:139) ..Allah (swt) is saying. As long as you
are believers, you will be raised high, you will be high, great.Don't be afraid! "Inna Allaha
Ma`ana(9:40)Allah is with us" said Allah(jj). He is informing his Prophet (sAws). When as-Siddiq
(ra) was worried, Allah (swt) told His Habib (sAws)... tell your companion, "La Tahzan Inna
Allaha Ma`ana "(9:40) Well this is us. We lost our personality our faith. We are wasting our
religion. Shame. That is why this intensity came to me, I am holding it for 3 days. I am like a
volcano. I feel like a volcano inside. I am poor, I am useless but...They put watches on their
wrists. Don't put! Don't adorn yourself - decoration is for ladies, not men. Keep your rings
simple. Don't put on the first (finger). Put instead of bracelets. no golden watches, different kinds
of watches..

RasuluLlah (sAws) said... Shah Mardan is saying... "Man Tashabbaha Bi Qawmin Fa huwa
Minhum" Don't look like women! Our Sharia' says SubhanAllah! A man, without a wife...
Akmaluddin understands my language, if he doesn't have a wife &he's washing his laundry, they
say don't do like this women do like this, a man without a wife... When he is doing his laundry,
he should do it like a man. It is this sensitive; don't copy them, don't be like them. Men who listen
to women lose their manhood; his manly honor is lost. When women control men, the world
becomes terrible, & it is now terrible. Do not be like them and do not act like them. "Man
Tashabbaha Bi Qawmin Fa huwa Minhum" What right do you have; Islamic countries are
following Jewish & Christain priest's made-up... ...program. They put the time one hour ahead.
Does Allah (swt) bring the sun forward or backward? What disgrace is this? What ignorance is
this, shame!
I am giving fatwa for all of them. You are outside of Islam, because, "Man Tashabbaha Bi
Qawmin Fa huwa Minhum"... There is power. I am nothing, but I am saying the rights of

Sharia'. Don't oppose! You will not make it to Rajab,Ramadan, or Eid. Change the time,
quickly. Make an Islamic time. Let them follow you, not you follow them. The head does not
follow the tail. The tail follows head . "My wife wants like this, to dress like this." No! There is
no fashion in Islam. They still want, in the Holy Lands, the ladies want... May Allah (swt)
increase the King's power -give us permission to drive cars- the king's rank will increase - I am
not giving permission. If you shout, if you give me the whole world, I won't give ladies
permission. Good for you, King! Take away the paper oh Muslims. Don't do any business with
paper, No. Trade... is to be with gold and silver, valuable things "Man Tashabbaha Bi Qawmin
Fahuwa Minhum" Europe's Jewish & Christian priests... that is what they ordered; they got rid
of gold/silver and brought paper. Neither their trade, nor what they sell or buy is halal
(permissible).
This is Islam, we have honor. Oh kings, listen. This bombardment is not from me. I am not
interfering, I am just informing Fix the time and bring Islamic time. Use Islamic time which is
according to sunset. Our day starts when the sun sets. These ones, their day starts in the middle
of night, in pitch dark. Our day starts after Maghrib prayer, it opens, opens, opens. O Islam!
Where are you? O Shah Mardan, where are you? What can I do? To say this they gave me a 3
day notice. Now, they said, bombard them, don't be afraid. Most of their souls will be taken if
they don't fix their time. Islam has honor. Don't play with time. And your time... Islamic time,
they call it Alaturka.
None of the Sultans used Western time but these ones have western watches on their arms, and
the most expensive... fancy watches. Adornment is for women. Men don't adorn themselves!
Men are men.What stupid people have we become. There is shiddah (intensity) now and now,
what did Prophet (sAws) mention about this? "And you will follow the steps of the nations before
you..."(Hadith) He mentioned, he knows their weaknesses, Prophet (sAws) Don't follow them!
Rid your countries of the of the affliction called fashion. O ladies, don't follow fashion! The
dress you wear following fashion... In the grave it will be fire & burn you. Dont pester your
husband buy me this & that. Your beauty is only for your husband and mahrem (close relatives).
Change it O Kings, change the watch on your hands. If you don't, there's a 40 day notice to go
to the other side. O Shah Mardan draw Dhul Fiqqar. There is permission now. Let's see until
Rajab. I am not from those asking for monthly salary. I am a weak, poor servant. I am weak, but

for 3 days I am holding on to this addressing. Allah says "Who imitates a people is one of them."
(Hadith) Don't be like them, I am saying. Don't look like them. We sacrificed everything for
Europe. Shame on Muslims, shame on princes, presidents, leaders. Democracy... what
democracy? May Hz. Ali's (ra) sword cut the heads of... those believing in democracy. And then
what did we do? O, let the Jewish priests come, let's beg them to give us weapons. What weapons
do you need? say, Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. It will destroy all of them, one majzub
(attracted one) one who has power to attract. O Kings listen!Shah Mardan isn't reading stories
He is Shah Mardan, Owner of the Arena, Shah Mardan, Ay Habib ar-Rahman! Ay Sultan!
Sayyidina Ali ibni Abi Talib. Shah Mardan, Sultan of the arenas!
O holy ones, what can we do? In order to say this... they didn't give me permission for 3daysthey
said, don't say. Now you can say. Now there is permission to speak. Happiness to the souls
of thoselistening Those listening will save themselves; those not listening, by Ramadan... armies
will make them go, O Akmalluddin effendi, don't wear pants one more time; don't wear jacket,
tie. Understand? If not, you will go to the other side too. they will now bring those who
understand Rajabun Ajayibun. Allahu akbar! Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar Wa Lillahi l-Hamd.
Dhul Fiqqar is ready, it will take their heads off especially those leaders who say we are this and
that and oppress the people. Maybe, they won't make it to Ramadan; their heads will fly. They
should beware!
We are Ikhwan, Shia, we are this and that; those who say this... they should all be afraid,
tremble. Those opposing Kings, most will go. And kings, as we said, should be kings of Islam,
their heads will be at ease. They shouldn't listen to their ladies. If they do, they won't see
paradise. Look at the sensitivity in Islam "Who imitates a people is one of them"(Hadith) Alayhi
as-Salatu wa as-salam. Don't look like them or their western fashion. That is made-up by
European priests; they ordered and time was put ahead 1 hour. What does this mean? They are
holding me back for 3 days. Make a heavy bombardment about this, I was given permission last
night. How is my talk? It's Astonishing!
I have no power. I am nothing; but, I will make this world a riot, an earthquake. I will raise the
Banner of Islam. Let them follow us. We don't need to follow them. O kings, princes,
presidents... don't touch the time - let your time be Islamic time or else, you'll leave without faith.
We seek refuge in Allah, don't make empty claims. People don't get honor by killing. "Wa Man

Ahyaha Faka'annama Ahya An-Nasa Jami`aan" (5:32) Don't kill! Allah's order: "Wa La Taqtulu
'Anfusakum" (4:29) Don't kill! Without My order no one should kill. They are not listening, they
will all be shredded. I am angry, I have anger on me. I don't have anything, but,Shah Mardan's
power - If you put cigarette in your mouth ,in the grave you'll suffocate from smoke, come back
to life...suffocate..come back. Those wearing fancy clothes... men and women will wear clothes
of fire. Take care of the Sunnah, take care of Allah's Habib's way. Live like a Muslim, or else...
Until Ramadan I'll have revenge on them.
A Divine Decree has come from S. Mardan they will all go. Ya Rabbi forgive us. We're asking
for servants who'll show us our way, who understand the way of Islam For 3 days, they're saying
we'll change the time 1 hour ahead. How can it be? It is revenge for this. They held me for 3 days
because this bombardment.. never came before. This power never came before. Now, they won't
leave anyone from Iranians, Turks, Saudis, from Sham, those not coming to right way will go to
grave. women who are not listening either go to mental hospital or grave. listen O Kings take
care of Islamic dress, put crown of Islam on your heads so nothing will harm you. Why are you
running after them? Who is China, Russia? is China, Russia, Europe, or America going to
defeat the armies of Allah? We are not making any noise, but the time has come and the sword
will be drawn
"La Tattabi`Khutuwati sh-shaytani" (24:21) They are all satans. Don't follow them, Allah (swt)
is saying. O Kings Mursi is sitting on the chair, the chair will sit on his head. This person, that
person, leave these games, take care of Allah's servants, serve His servants. Don't make them
servants to you. Parliament assembly. No! It is false. Don't we have Sharia'? When there is
Sharia', why do you make a constitution?(spit) on your constiution. When there is Allah's Sharia,
Astaizzu BiLlah "Inna Allaha Ya'muru Bil`Adli Wa Al Ihsani Wa Ita'i Dhil Qurba Wa Yanha
Ani Al-Fahsha'i Wa Al-Munkari Wa Al-Baghyi Ya`izukum La`allakum Tadhakkaruna(16:90)
This is our constitution, The Quran.
O scholars of Egypt why are you afraid? Why afraid of ignorant ones? Why don't you show the
majesty of Islam? O Azhar, the ones in Turkey, Saudi Arabia, all of you, fear Allah! Enforce the
Sharia' or else something will come on your heads. Don't kill people. Try to make them live.
Take care of Adab. Allah... gave you the rank of Islam, don't use it in the worng way. You will
say "hik" and die right there. Take off those ornaments your hand.Say Akmaluddin (Ihsan) son,

say: don't wear valuable watches. Let the chain of a watch be seen & Europe can follow our
time if they want We are not obliged to follow their time. That is why I didn't change my clock.
My watch is alaturka - it starts from sunset. This one is upside down, the day starts in the
middle of night. Can the day start in the middle of night? Don't you have a sturdy meter?
Daytime is between sunrise & sunset after that is night. Sharia' has appointed the day & night.
No. We are making up this and that. Well, you will collapse if you don't listen to this advice,
both Iran's leader, or Turk's leader or Egypt's drunk one, or in Saudi Arabia.. the ones who ride
cars and airplanes with arrogance. Leave this. Ride on camels, it'll give you honor. Our master
(sAws) rode (camels). Go out into the arena like that, with a sword. Don't fear, Islam is the
highest! Muslims have honor. Don't change the time, you won't reach the end. O ignorant ones!
We hope Allah (swt) doesn't make us from ignorant ones. How can you be Muslim if you don't
even know the days or time? How can we deal with Muslims? We are the heads, they say. Aman
Ya Rabbi Send us a Sultan who will unite Muslim world & make world of kufur tremble. Send us
a Sultan Ya Rabbi! Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar! Allahu akbar Wa Lillahi'l Hamd. Fatiha.
O princes, O princes! You are responsible on Judgement Day. Prepare how you will answer.
Who will be under the banner of Prophet(sas) You will see. Who will be sent away from the
source of Kawthar? You will see. You will see who won't be able to pass Sirat. Aman Ya Rabbi!
Tawba Ya Rabbi. I am a helpless servant. I am angry at my own ego. I am like a volcano. For
all Islamic naitons these are the ways to save yourselves. Sharia' Garrawun Ahmadiyya. What
constitution? When there is Sharia' Garrawun Ahmadiyya They are saying to make constitution.
Who are you & your (...) inventions? Why are you meddling with the Constitution? Are you god?
I am ashamed to say"Allah" We are making laws, constitutions. Make it and drown in it ! La
Hawla Wa La Quwwata illa Billah.... Fatiha

Prophet (saws) darüber? 'Und ihr werdet den Schritten der Nationen vor euch folgen..' (Hadith),
sagte er. Er kennt ihre Schwächen, der Prophet (saws). Folgt ihnen nicht! Befreit euch von der

Heimsuchung, genannt Mode, in eueren Ländern. O Frauen, folgt nicht der Mode! Das modische
Kleid, das ihr tragt, wird im Grab Feuer sein und euch verbrennen. Löchert nicht eueren Mann,
'Kauf mir dies und das'. Euere Schönheit ist nur für eueren Mann und Mahram (nahe
Verwandte). Ändert es, o Könige, ändert die Uhren an eueren Handgelenken. Wenn nicht, gibt es
eine 40 tägige Vorwarnung, auf die andere Seite zu gehen.
O Shah Mardan ziehe Dhu l-Fiqqar. Es gibt jetzt Erlaubnis. Sehen wir mal bis Rajab. Ich gehöre
nicht zu denen, die monatliches Gehalt wollen. Ich bin ein schwacher, armer Diener. Ich bin
schwach, aber seit 3 Tagen halte ich diese Ansprache fest. Allah: 'Wer ein Volk nachahmt, ist
einer von ihnen.' (Hadith) Seid nicht wie sie, sage ich. Seht nicht wie sie aus. Wir opferten alles
für Europa, Schande auf die Muslime, Schande auf die Prinzen, Präsidenten, Führer. Demokratie..
Welche Demokratie? Möge Hz Alis (ra) Schwert die Köpfe dieser abschlagen, die an
Demokratie glauben. Und dann, was taten wir? O, laß die jüdischen Priester kommen, betteln
wir, daß sie uns Waffen geben! Welche Waffen braucht ihr? Sagt: Bismillahi r-Rahmani rRahim. Es wird sie alle zerstören. Ein Madjzub (von Allah angezogener), einer, der die Macht
hat anzuziehen, o Könige, hört. Shah Mardan liest keine Geschichten vor. Er ist Shah Mardan,
Eigner des Kampfplatzes, Ay Habibu r-Rahman, Ay Sultan! Sayyidina Ali ibn Abi Talib, Shah
Mardan, Sultan der Kampfplätze!
O Heilige, was können wir tun? Um das zu sagen, gaben sie mir 3 Tage keine Erlaubnis. Sie
sagten: Sag es nicht. Jetzt kannst du es sagen: Jetzt gibt es Erlaubnis zu sprechen, Glück für die
Seelen jener, die hören. Jene, die hören, werden sich retten. Jene, die nicht hören, bis zum
Ramadan werden Armeen sie zum Gehen veranlassen. O Akmaluddin Effendi, trage nicht noch
mal Hosen, trage kein Jackett, Schlips, verstehst du? Sonst wirst du auch auf die andere Seite
gehen. Sie bringen jetzt die, die verstehen. Rajabun Ajayibun. Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar!
Allahu Akbar wa Lillahi l-Hamd. Dhu l-Fiqqar ist bereit, es wird die Köpfe fliegen lassen,
besonders jener, der Führer, die sagen, 'Wir sind dies und das', und die Leute unterdrücken.
Vielleicht schaffen sie es nicht bis Ramadan. Ihre Köpfe fliegen weg. Sie sollten sich hüten. Wir
sind Ikhwan, Shia, wir sind dies und das. Jene, die das sagen, sollten sich fürchten, zittern. Jene,
die gegen Könige sind, die meisten gehen, und Könige, wie gesagt, sollten Könige des Islam
sein, ihre Köpfe werden ruhig sein. Sie sollten nicht auf ihre Frauen hören. Wenn doch, werden
sie das Paradies nicht sehen. Seht die Feinheit im Islam: 'Wer ein Volk nachahmt, ist einer von

ihnen.' `Alayhi s-Salatu wa s-Salam. Seht sie nicht an oder ihre westliche Mode. Das ist von
europäischen Priestern ersonnen.
Sie befahlen, und die Zeit wurde eine Stunde vorgestellt. Was bedeutet das? Sie halten mich 3
Tage zurück, um dieses schwere Bombardement darüber zu machen. Ich bekam die Erlaubnis
letzte Nacht. Wie ist meine Rede? Sie ist erstaunlich! Ich habe keine Macht. Ich bin nichts, aber
ich bringe diese Welt in Aufruhr, ein Erdbeben.. Ich erhebe das Banner des Islam. Sie sollen uns
folgen. Wir brauchen ihnen nicht zu folgen. Oh Könige, Prinzen, Präsidenten.. Rührt die Zeit
nicht an! Eure Zeit sei die Islamische Zeit, sonst bleibt ihr ohne Glauben, wir suchen Zuflucht
bei Allah. Stellt keine leeren Behauptungen auf. Die Menschen bekommen keine Ehre durch
Töten. "Wa man Ahyaha Faka'annama Ahya n-Nasa Jami`aan" (5:32) - Und wer ihn am Leben
erhält, so ist es, als ob er alle Menschen am Leben erhält. Tötet nicht! Allahs Befehl: "Wa la
Taqtulu Anfusakum" (4:29). Tötet nicht! Ohne Meinen Befehl sollte keiner getötet werden. Sie
hören nicht. Sie werden alle zerfetzt. Ich bin zornig, voller Zorn in mir. Ich habe nichts, aber
Shah Mardans Macht, wenn ihr euch eine Zigarette ansteckt, werdet ihr im Grab vom Rauch
ersticken, wiederbelebt werden.. ersticken.. wiederkommen.. Die schicke Kleider tragen, Männer
und Frauen, werden Kleider aus Feuer tragen. Achtet auf die Sunnah, achtet auf den Weg von
Allahs Habib. Lebt wie ein Muslim, sonst werde Ich bis Ramadan Rache an ihnen nehmen. Ein
Göttlicher Befehl ist gekommen von Shah Mardan. Sie werden alle gehen.
Ya Rabbi, vergib uns. Wir bitten um Diener, die uns unseren Weg zeigen, die den Weg des Islam
verstehen. 3 Tage lang.. Sie sagen, wir stellen die Zeit eine Stunde vor. Wie kann das sein? Es
gibt Rache dafür. Sie hielten mich für 3 Tage, weil dieses Bombardement nicht vorher kam,
diese Macht kam noch nie vorher. Jetzt werden sie niemanden von den Iranern, Türken, Saudis,
von Sham übrig lassen. Jene, die nicht zum rechten Weg kommen, werden ins Grab gehen.
Frauen, die nicht hören, gehen entweder ins Irrenhaus oder ins Grab. Hört, o Könige, kümmert
euch um die Islamische Kleiderordnung. Setzt die Krone des Islam auf, damit euch nichts
schaden kann. Warum lauft ihr hinter ihnen her? Wer ist China, Rußland? Werden China,
Rußland, Europa oder Amerika die Armeen Allahs besiegen? Wir machen keinen Lärm, aber die
Zeit ist da, und das Schwert ist gezogen. "La Tattabi` Khutuwati sh-Shaytan" (24:21). Sie sind
alle Shaytane. Folgt ihnen nicht, sagt Allah (swt). O Könige, Mursi sitzt auf dem Stuhl, der Stuhl
wird ihm auf dem Kopf sitzen. Diese Person, jene Person, laßt diese Spiele. Kümmert euch um

die Diener Allahs, dient Seinen Dienern. Macht sie nicht zu eueren Dienern.
Parlamentssitzungen, nein! Es ist falsch. Haben wir nicht die Shari`at? Wenn es die Shari`at gibt,
warum macht ihr eine Verfassung? 'Ptu' auf euere Verfassung, wo es doch Allahs Shari`at gibt.
Astaizzu Billah: "Inna Allaha Ya'muru bi l-`Adli wa l-Ihsani wa Ita'i Dhi l-Qurba wa Yanha ani
l-Fahsha'i wa l-Munkari wa l-Baghyi Ya`izukum La`allakum Tadhakkaruna" (16:90) - Allah
gebietet Gerechtigkeit, gütig zu sein und den Verwandten zu geben. Er verbietet das Schändliche,
das Verwerfliche und die Gewalttätigkeit. Er ermahnt euch, auf daß ihr bedenken möget.
Das ist unsere Verfassung, Der Quran. O Gelehrte Ägyptens, warum fürchtet ihr euch? Warum
fürchtet ihr Ignoranten? Warum zeigt ihr nicht die Majestät des Islam? Ay Azhar, die in der
Türkei, Saudi Arabien, ihr alle, fürchtet Allah! Setzt die Shari`at durch, sonst wird etwas auf
euren Kopf kommen. Tötet Leute nicht. Versucht sie leben zu lassen. Achtet auf gutes
Benehmen. Allah gab euch den Rang des Islam, nutzt ihn nicht auf falsche Weise. Ihr sagt 'hik'
und sterbt genau dort. Nehmt diesen Schmuck ab von euerer Hand. Sag, Akmaluddin, Sohn, sag:
Tragt keine wertvollen Uhren. Laßt eine Uhrenkette sichtbar werden, und Europa kann unserer
Zeit folgen, wenn sie wollen. Wir sind nicht verpflichtet, ihrer Zeit zu folgen. Deshalb habe ich
meine Uhr nicht verstellt. Meine Uhr ist Alaturka. Sie beginnt mit dem Sonnenuntergang. Diese
stehen auf dem Kopf: Der Tag fängt mitten in der Nacht an. Kann der Tag mitten in der Nacht
anfangen? Habt ihr kein stabiles Maß? Die Tageszeit ist zwischen Sonnenaufgang und -untergang,
danach ist Nacht. Die Shari`at hat Tag und Nacht bestimmt. 'Nein, wir denken uns dies und
das aus.' Nun, ihr werdet zusammenbrechen, wenn ihr nicht auf diesen Rat hört, Irans Führer
oder der Führer der Türkei oder Ägyptens Betrunkener oder in Saudi Arabien.. Diejenigen, die
Autos und Flugzeuge mit Arroganz fahren. Laßt das, reitet auf Kamelen. Es gibt euch Ehre.
Unser Meister (saws) ritt Kamele.
Geht so hinaus in die Arena, mit einem Schwert. Fürchtet euch nicht. Islam ist das höchste.
Muslime haben Ehre. Ändert nicht die Zeit, ihr werdet das Ende nicht erreichen, Ignoranten. Wir
hoffen, Allah (swt) läßt uns nicht einer der Ignoranten sein. Wie könnt ihr Muslim sein, wenn ihr
nicht mal die Tage oder die Zeit kennt? Wie können wir mit Muslimen umgehen? Wir sind die
Köpfe, sagen sie. Sende uns einen Sultan, der die Muslimwelt zusammenbringt und die Welt des
Kufr erzittern läßt. Sende uns einen Sultan, ya Rabbi! Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar! Allahu

Akbar wa Lillahi l-Hamd. Fatiha. O Prinzen, o Prinzen! Ihr seid verantwortlich am Gerichtstag.
Bereitet vor, wie ihr antworten werdet. Wer unter dem Banner des Propheten (saws) sein wird,
werdet ihr sehen. Wer weggeschickt wird von der Quelle Kawthar, werdet ihr sehen. Ihr werdet
sehen, wer den Sirat nicht wird überqueren können. Aman ya Rabbi. Tawba ya Rabbi. Ich bin ein
hilfloser Diener. Ich bin zornig auf mein eigenes Ego. Ich bin wie ein Vulkan für alle
Islamischen Nationen. Dies sind die Wege, euch zu retten. Shari`at Garrawun Ahmadiyya.
Welche Verfassung? Wenn es doch die Shari`at Garrawin Ahmadiyya gibt. Sie sagen: Wir
machen eine Verfassung. Wer seid ihr und euere Erfindungen? Warum mischt ihr euch ein mit
der Verfassung? Seid ihr Gott? Ich schäme mich zu sagen 'Allah'. Wir machen Gesetze,
Verfassungen. Macht sie und ertrinkt darin! La Hawla wa la Quwwata illa Billah. Fatiha. Also, 3
Tage lang hatte ich keine Erlaubnis, diese Rede zu halten. Wer will, kann nehmen, wer nicht,
kann sein Grab bereiten. Fatiha.
